gui.merequester.no_requesters: 未找到 ME 合成請求器！
tooltip.merequester.requester_desc: Automatically keeps items and fluids in stock by requesting new crafts when needed. Has to be connected to an ME network and can be accessed from an ME Requester Terminal. Will lose its configuration when broken. Settings can be copied with a Memory Card.
tooltip.merequester.shift_for_more: 按住 %s 取得更多資訊
tooltip.merequester.idle_desc: The Requester is idling when the requested amount is already reached or there is no crafting pattern for this item or fluid.
tooltip.merequester.missing_desc: The system is missing ingredients to craft the requested item or fluid. The process is continued when the ingredients are available.
tooltip.merequester.cpu_desc: The system can't find a suitable CPU for the craft. The process is continued when a CPU is found.
tooltip.merequester.link_desc: 系統正在合成請求的目標物品或流體。
tooltip.merequester.export_desc: 請求器正在嘗試將合成產物輸出至系統中。若請求器長時間處於此狀態，表示系統沒有可用的空間可以輸出。
